name: sphere
description: Dielectric sphere scattering cross-section from a closed TFSF box (TorchFDTD, FDTDX) or a Meep native plane-wave-plus-flux-box setup.

reference.note: Bohren-Huffman a_n/b_n with SciPy spherical Bessel functions, as in examples/tfsf_sphere.py.

fdtdx_plane_source.kind: UniformPlaneSource one-way plane (no closed TFSF box in fdtdx 0.6.2)
fdtdx_plane_source.note: Spans the full y,z domain including the PML; the flux box faces lie in the total-field region, so the empty-domain phasors are subtracted before the scattered flux is integrated.

meep_plane_source.kind: planewave current sheet spanning the full cell (Meep Mie tutorial setup, no TFSF box)
meep_plane_source.note: Ez current sheet at the PML interface spanning the full cell including the PML; scattered flux = total-run flux minus empty-run DFT fields (load_minus_flux_data).
